description: The Google Meet meetings one account took part in, each with its transcripts, smart notes (Gemini's notes) and recordings, as Meet records them: for a calendar event (event_id from agenda: its Meet call, and for one occurrence the sitting that started within an hour of it), for a Meet link or code (meeting), or else for the last days (at most 30: Meet keeps records 30 days). A transcript or notes is a Google Doc: its document id opens with read_document; get_transcript reads a transcript as lines with who said what. Reading an event needs the account's calendar grant too.

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts; empty means the first one with a grant.

days.description: Without event_id or meeting: how many days back.

event_id.description: An event's eventId from agenda, in this account's calendar.

meeting.description: A Meet link (https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij) or its code.

name: list_meetings
title: List meetings
